title: Liminal
description:
Project is intended to be interactive fiction (IF), but on-chain. The future states will incorporate modularity for on-chain events, price feeds, etc.

THe Story is supposed to slightly change based on the number of iterations, but never had enough non-work time to flesh that out
how_its_made:
I used Twine, planned to use Matic for L2 and figure out ZK wrapping of content. The actual version will use ethereum, some form of Zero-knowledge, and an L2 solution in order to allow for high-throughput



And use web3.js to connect front-end to blockchain

Didn't impress myself, had no time
